trails.why: A footpath to the summit: 5.2 km each way, +1,014 m, up to 5,094 m, from near Doğubayazıt.

trails.name: Kaçkar Dağı summit
trails.why: Mount Kaçkar, with an elevation of 3,937 meters, is the highest peak in the Kaçkar Mountains.

trails.name: Mount Little Ararat
trails.why: Little Ararat, also known as Mount Sis or Lesser Ararat, is the sixth tallest peak in Turkey.

trails.name: Mount Artos
trails.why: Mount Artos is a mountain in Van Province in eastern Turkey. It has a height of 3,515 meters above sea level, and is located at 38° 27' 1 N, 43° 29' 30 E.

trails.name: Medetsiz Mountain summit
trails.why: Medetsiz Mountain is a summit in Toros Mountains range of Turkey. It is a part of Çamlıyayla of Mersin Province.

trails.name: Kösedağ summit
trails.why: Mount Kösedağ is a mountain located in Eleşkirt district of Ağrı, Turkey. It is approximately 20 km away from the district center.

trails.name: Aydos Dağı summit
trails.why: Aydos Mountain is a mountain in the Halkapınar district of Konya, at an altitude of 3430 meters.

trails.name: Mount Hasan
trails.why: Mount Hasan is a volcano in Anatolia, Turkey. It has two summits, the 3,069 metres high eastern Small Hasan Dagi and the 3,253 metres high Big Hasan Dagi, and rises about 1 kilometre above the surrounding terrain.

trails.name: Mount Nemrut
trails.why: Nemrut is a dormant volcano in Eastern Turkey, close to Lake Van. The volcano is named after King Nimrod who is said to have ruled this area in about 2100 BC.The most powerful eruptions of Nemrut occurred in the Pleistocene.

trails.name: Mount Davraz
trails.why: Mount Davraz, also sometimes cited as Mount Davras, is a mountain and a winter sports and ski resort in the Taurus Mountains in Isparta Province in southern Turkey.

trails.name: Deniz Lake
trails.why: Deniz Gölü or Lake Big Peshevit, is a glacial lake in Çamlıhemşin district of Rize Province and İspir district of Erzurum Province in Turkey.
